name: budi-luhur-ecosystem
description: Ekosistem Tiga Aplikasi Mandiri Berbasis Fe-Tablet dengan Landing Page Portal Budi-Luhur

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "portal,app1-be,app1-fe,app2-be,app2-fe,app3-be,app3-fe" -c "yellow,blue,cyan,green,emerald,magenta,pink" "npm run dev:portal" "npm run dev:app1:backend" "npm run dev:app1:frontend" "npm run dev:app2:backend" "npm run dev:app2:frontend" "npm run dev:app3:backend" "npm run dev:app3:frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix apps/app1/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/app1/frontend run build && npm --prefix apps/app2/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/app2/frontend run build && npm --prefix apps/app3/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/app3/frontend run build
scripts.db:init:all: npm --prefix apps/app1/backend run db:init && npm --prefix apps/app2/backend run db:init && npm --prefix apps/app3/backend run db:init
scripts.db:seed:all: npm --prefix apps/app1/backend run db:seed && npm --prefix apps/app2/backend run db:seed && npm --prefix apps/app3/backend run db:seed
